output_list.reason: Integer overflow in transferFrom function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'amount * allowance' in the if-statement, allowing a malicious user to set 'amount' to 0 and increase 'allowance' arbitrarily.
Integer overflow in mintToken function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'mintedAmount + balanceOf[target]' in the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; line.
Integer overflow in distributeTokens function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'reward + balanceOf[holder]' in the balanceOf[holder] += reward; line.
Incorrect comparison in buy function allows attackers to set 'amount * buyPrice' to any value, allowing arbitrary transfer of tokens.
Incorrect comparison in sell function allows attackers to set 'amount * sellPrice' to any value, allowing arbitrary transfer of tokens.
